tools.description: Search US federal and state regulatory documents ingested from official registers, with AI summaries, agencies, effective dates, and source URLs. Funding opportunities are excluded unless you pass category "funding"; use search_funding_programs for grants and incentive programs. Results are sorted newest first and every result includes a citation URL. Covers the last 90 days, up to 25 results per call.

agency.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the issuing agency name.

category.description: Document category: "regulation" or "funding". Omit to include all documents, including unclassified ones.

from.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only documents published on or after this date.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction: "US_FED" for federal, or a US state as a two-letter code like "CA", "NY", "TX" (full names and "US_STATE_CA" also work). Omit for all jurisdictions.

keyword.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against title, AI summary, and description.

to.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only documents published on or before this date.

tools.description: Fetch one regulatory document by id: title, jurisdiction, agencies, category, published and effective dates, AI summary, full description, and the canonical source URL to cite.

tools.description: Everything published since a given date, optionally for one jurisdiction, newest first. Designed for scheduled or recurring agents: store the newest publishedDate you have seen and pass it back as `since` on the next run. Covers the last 90 days, up to 25 results per call.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction: "US_FED" for federal, or a US state as a two-letter code like "CA", "NY", "TX" (full names and "US_STATE_CA" also work). Omit for all jurisdictions.

offset.description: Pagination offset. Default 0. Combine with total in the response to page.

since.description: ISO date or timestamp. Returns documents published on or after this moment.
